Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a life insurance policy for national guard members called to active duty.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to active duty members of the national guard;adding a new section to chapter 38.40 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 38.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Every member of the national guard called into active duty shall beissued a life insurance policy with a benefit of two hundred fiftythousand dollars. The premium for the policy shall be paid out of thegeneral fund of Washington for the period of time that the member ofthe national guard is on active duty. Under this section, "active duty" means active state service,active training duty, and federal service.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
